title: Postgres DB connection timeout
description: Database connections timing out, API returning 503 errors
root_cause: Max connection limit reached due to connection pool misconfiguration
resolution: Increased max_connections in postgresql.conf from 100 to 300, restarted service

title: High CPU on API server
description: API server CPU at 98%, requests dropping
root_cause: Infinite loop in data processing job triggered by malformed input
resolution: Killed the rogue process, added input validation, redeployed

title: Redis cache memory full
description: Redis out of memory, cache writes failing silently
root_cause: TTL not set on session keys, memory filled over 48 hours
resolution: Flushed expired keys, set default TTL of 3600s on all session keys

title: Kubernetes pod crash loop
root_cause: Missing environment variable PAYMENT_API_KEY after config map update
resolution: Added missing env var to config map, rolled out new deployment

title: SSL certificate expired
description: Users getting SSL error on main domain, site unreachable
root_cause: Auto-renewal cron job failed silently 30 days ago
resolution: Manually renewed cert via certbot, fixed cron job, added expiry monitoring

title: Disk space full on log server
description: Log ingestion stopped, monitoring alerts not firing
root_cause: Log rotation policy not applied to new microservices added last sprint
resolution: Cleared old logs, applied logrotate config to all services

title: S3 bucket access denied
description: File upload feature broken, users getting 403 errors
root_cause: IAM role policy expired after 90-day rotation, not updated
resolution: Updated IAM role with new policy, redeployed Lambda functions

title: API rate limit hitting third-party service
root_cause: Bulk email job not respecting rate limits, exhausted daily quota
resolution: Added rate limiting with token bucket algorithm, scheduled bulk jobs off-peak

title: Docker image pull failing in CI/CD
description: All deployments failing with image pull error
root_cause: Docker Hub rate limit hit due to unauthenticated pulls from CI runners
resolution: Added Docker Hub credentials to CI secrets, switched to authenticated pulls

title: Memory leak in Node.js service
description: User auth service memory growing until OOM kill every 6 hours
root_cause: Event listeners not removed on WebSocket disconnect, accumulating over time
resolution: Added proper cleanup in disconnect handler, memory stable after fix
